messages:
Maria L.: pushed a quick mock — persistent banner vs inline helper for the initial setup flow. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/onboarding-banner-mock — want quick takes on discoverability + accessibility Devin: banner wins for discoverability. Inline helper feels easy to miss on larger dashboards. :thinking_face: but have concerns about screen-reader reading order Annar: banner can push down the canvas which is annoying for users who land and just want to check logs. Can we add a small 'Resume setup' affordance in the Help menu so users can reopen it later? Sam K.: did a quick keyboard run: current banner traps focus if we autofocus the CTA. Repro: open -> focus lands on CTA -> tab cycles inside. Suggest adding a skip link and don't autofocus. Example snippet: ``` Skip setup
...
``` Maria L.: good catch — plan: make banner non-modal, add a visible skip link that shifts focus to #main, and add a persistent control in the Help menu to re-open the helper. Also tweaked CTA copy to "Finish setup — recommended" in figma Product Bot: design-qa checklist: banner must not trap focus, must have aria-live polite for updates, small text contrast >= 4.5:1, keyboard shortcut to reopen if dismissed. See: https://redwood.design/qa-checklist Devin: for sample projects we should avoid auto-import on first show. Instead make "Try sample project" a secondary CTA that triggers an explicit import modal. Primary CTA completes the checklist. Annar: +1. For telemetry we need two events: onboard_banner_shown and sample_project_imported. Also record dismiss_reason when user closes the banner (:x: or 'already set up') Maria L.: updated figma with ARIA notes and a smaller compact banner variant (bottom-left) — reduced height to avoid pushing nav. Adding contrast note: subtitle at 3.8:1 currently, I'll patch colors Sam K.: 3.8 is below AA for small text. Options: increase subtitle size to 13–14px bold or tweak color to hit 4.5:1. Prefer size bump for consistency with other banners Devin: I'll coordinate with copy on the CTA — short is better: primary "Complete setup" secondary "Try sample project". Also we should run 3 remote unmoderated sessions next week to validate discoverability (:eyes:) DesignQA Bot: user-testing session created: 2026-03-30 10:00 AM PT. Link: https://calendar.example/event/xyz Maria L.: thanks — I'll open a tiny PR with the non-blocking banner and skip-focus behavior. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/487. Patch includes aria-live, skip link, and analytics hooks Sam K.: LGTM pending keyboard tests and unit for focus shift. I'll add a Cypress snippet to assert document.activeElement after pressing skip. Devin: perfect. After QA we can A/B the banner position (top vs bottom-left) and measure click-through and completion rate. :chart_with_upwards_trend: Maria L.: awesome. follow-ups: 1) copy sync w/ copywriter, 2) fix subtitle contrast, 3) add reopen in Help, 4) telemetry keys. I'll post updates in this thread when PR is ready Annar: thanks all — nice focused convo. :thumbsup:
